# iosxr_rsvp (Resource)

This resource can manage the RSVP configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxr_rsvp" "example" {
  authentication_key_chain                          = "KEY1"
  authentication_life_time                          = 60
  authentication_retransmit                         = 120
  authentication_window_size                        = 32
  bandwidth_mam_percentage_max_reservable_bandwidth = 10000
  bandwidth_mam_percentage_max_reservable_bc0       = 2000
  bandwidth_mam_percentage_max_reservable_bc1       = 2000
  bandwidth_rdm_percentage_max_reservable_bc0       = 10000
  bandwidth_rdm_percentage_max_reservable_bc1       = 2000
  interfaces = [
    {
      authentication_key_chain                                     = "KEY1"
      authentication_life_time                                     = 60
      authentication_window_size                                   = 32
      bandwidth_mam_percentage_bc0_total                           = 80
      bandwidth_mam_percentage_bc1_total                           = 20
      bandwidth_mam_percentage_flow                                = 20
      bandwidth_mam_percentage_total                               = 80
      interface_name                                               = "GigabitEthernet0/0/0/1"
      signalling_dscp                                              = 48
      signalling_hello_graceful_restart_interface_based            = true
      signalling_rate_limit_enable                                 = true
      signalling_rate_limit_interval                               = 1000
      signalling_rate_limit_rate                                   = 200
      signalling_refresh_interval                                  = 120
      signalling_refresh_missed                                    = 2
      signalling_refresh_oob_interval                              = 200
      signalling_refresh_oob_missed                                = 2
      signalling_refresh_reduction_bundle_max_size                 = 1000
      signalling_refresh_reduction_reliable_ack_hold_time          = 1000
      signalling_refresh_reduction_reliable_ack_max_size           = 2000
      signalling_refresh_reduction_reliable_retransmit_queue_depth = 100
      signalling_refresh_reduction_reliable_retransmit_time        = 1000
      signalling_refresh_reduction_reliable_summary_refresh        = true
      signalling_refresh_reduction_summary_max_size                = 100
    }
  ]
  latency_threshold                = 120
  logging_events_issu              = true
  logging_events_nsr               = true
  ltrace_buffer_multiplier         = 3
  ltrace_buffer_multiplier_common  = true
  ltrace_buffer_multiplier_dbg_err = true
  ltrace_buffer_multiplier_intf    = true
  ltrace_buffer_multiplier_rare    = true
  ltrace_buffer_multiplier_sig     = true
  ltrace_buffer_multiplier_sig_err = true
  ltrace_buffer_multiplier_sync    = true
  neighbors = [
    {
      address                    = "192.168.1.1"
      authentication_key_chain   = "KEY1"
      authentication_life_time   = 60
      authentication_window_size = 32
    }
  ]
  signalling_checksum_disable                          = true
  signalling_event_per_pulse                           = 60
  signalling_graceful_restart                          = true
  signalling_graceful_restart_lsp_ctype                = true
  signalling_graceful_restart_recovery_time            = 300
  signalling_graceful_restart_restart_time             = 220
  signalling_hello_graceful_restart_refresh_interval   = 3000
  signalling_hello_graceful_restart_refresh_misses     = 5
  signalling_message_bundle_disable                    = true
  signalling_nodeid_subobject_disable                  = true
  signalling_oob_vrf                                   = "VRF1"
  signalling_patherr_state_removal_disable             = true
  signalling_prefix_filtering_acl                      = "ACL1"
  signalling_prefix_filtering_default_deny_action_drop = true
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `authentication_key_chain` (String) Use key-chain to authenticate RSVP signalling messages
- `authentication_life_time` (Number) Use to associate life-time for each security association
  - Range: `30`-`86400`
- `authentication_retransmit` (Number) Configure retransmit options
  - Range: `0`-`10000`
- `authentication_window_size` (Number) Use window-size to limit number of out-of-order messages
  - Range: `1`-`64`
- `bandwidth_mam_percentage_max_reservable_bandwidth` (Number) Maximum reservable bandwidth
  - Range: `0`-`10000`
- `bandwidth_mam_percentage_max_reservable_bc0` (Number) BC0 pool
  - Range: `0`-`10000`
- `bandwidth_mam_percentage_max_reservable_bc1` (Number) BC1 pool
  - Range: `0`-`10000`
- `bandwidth_rdm_percentage_max_reservable_bc0` (Number) Maximum reservable/BC0
  - Range: `0`-`10000`
- `bandwidth_rdm_percentage_max_reservable_bc1` (Number) BC1 pool
  - Range: `0`-`10000`
- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Enable RSVP on an interface (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `latency_threshold` (Number) Set the latency threshold to a value in seconds (default 60)
  - Range: `0`-`180`
- `logging_events_issu` (Boolean) Enable ISSU Status Logging
- `logging_events_nsr` (Boolean) Enable NSR Status Logging
- `ltrace_buffer_multiplier` (Number) trace buffer file size multiplier
  - Range: `2`-`6`
- `ltrace_buffer_multiplier_common` (Boolean) Common trace buffer
- `ltrace_buffer_multiplier_dbg_err` (Boolean) Debug errors trace buffer
- `ltrace_buffer_multiplier_intf` (Boolean) Interface trace buffer
- `ltrace_buffer_multiplier_rare` (Boolean) Rare trace buffer
- `ltrace_buffer_multiplier_sig` (Boolean) Signalling trace buffer
- `ltrace_buffer_multiplier_sig_err` (Boolean) Signalling errors trace buffer
- `ltrace_buffer_multiplier_sync` (Boolean) Sync trace buffer
- `neighbors` (Attributes List) Configure RSVP neighbors for RSVP authentication (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--neighbors))
- `signalling_checksum_disable` (Boolean) Disable RSVP message checksum computation/validation
- `signalling_event_per_pulse` (Number) Set Max event sent per pulse
  - Range: `0`-`1600`
- `signalling_graceful_restart` (Boolean) Configure RSVP Graceful-Restart parameters
- `signalling_graceful_restart_lsp_ctype` (Boolean) Configure to send LSP's ctype for Recovery and Suggested label
- `signalling_graceful_restart_recovery_time` (Number) Configure the recovery-time
  - Range: `0`-`3600`
- `signalling_graceful_restart_restart_time` (Number) Configure the restart-time
  - Range: `60`-`3600`
- `signalling_hello_graceful_restart_refresh_interval` (Number) Set interval between successive Hello messages
  - Range: `3000`-`30000`
- `signalling_hello_graceful_restart_refresh_misses` (Number) Set max number of consecutive missed Hello messages
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `signalling_message_bundle_disable` (Boolean) Disable bundling of outgoing RSVP messages
- `signalling_nodeid_subobject_disable` (Boolean) Disable inserting nodeid-subobject in RRO of Reservation
- `signalling_oob_vrf` (String) VRF used for out-of-band control signalling
- `signalling_patherr_state_removal_disable` (Boolean) Disable State-Removal flag for Path Error
- `signalling_prefix_filtering_acl` (String) Specify access-list name
- `signalling_prefix_filtering_default_deny_action_drop` (Boolean) Drop the packet

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxr_rsvp.example ""
```
